Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is it from this nail-biting thriller where South Africa takes a 2-1 lead. West Indies will look to come back stronger after back-to-back losses. They will  meet again on 1st July 0600 local (2000 GMT) for the fourth T20I where West Indies will be looking for revenge at all costs to level the series. Till then, goodbye and take care!

South Africa skipper, Temba Bavuma says that it is a big confidence boost for the team. Adds that these are the type of situations they like to find themselves in. Mentions that they will continue to have conversations with the staff and the team to reach the 180 mark but it is not a matter of concern for them. States that it was nice having Aiden at his disposal as it helps to have a sixth bowler. Says that Tabraiz makes his job a lot easier and Linde is learning from him. Finally says that it is important for them to keep working and let the result take care of itself.

West Indies skipper, Kieron Pollard says that getting off to a good start and not making the most of it hurts them. Tells they need to work on the dot balls they played. Pollard says time and time again one has such close matches and sometimes one ends up on the wrong side. Adds they need to find their way. Pollard credits the bowlers for their effort and says they have been excellent. Mentions Obed McCoy and says that he has shown that he is growing and tells the youngsters in the team are looking to grow.
Stay tuned for the presentations!

For his game-changing bowling performance, Tabraiz Shamsi is named the Player of the Match! Shamsi says that it was nice to put on a performance for the team. Adds that Quinny once again showed his class and the bowlers delivered it well. Mentions that he has to change his line and lengths according to the batsmen, says that this a young group of players and they are learning very quickly. Goes onto say that it is nice to bowl like this and is happy with the performance of the bowling unit. Finally says that the wickets are getting tougher and gives full credit to the batters as they started off really well.

Earlier in the day, South Africa were put to bat by Pollard. Quinton de Kock, on his 50th T20I, played a very good knock of 72. The Proteas on the back of that managed to get to 167. At one stage it looked like they would get a total in excess of 180 but they faltered with the bat at the death. They managed to get away with it this time as the hosts failed to find their way out of Shamsi's web. Obed McCoy was once again the star with the ball for West Indies as he finished with 4/22. His brilliant efforts though went in vain.

South Africa have made it two-in-two and taken the lead. There was a lot of chatter about their bowling in the death but the pace trio of Nortje, Rabada and Ngidi have delivered. Especially the former. His penultimate over changed the tide of the game. The real star of the show though was Tabraiz Shamsi. He was just too good. It looked like West Indies game when he came on to bowl but his 2/13 from 4 overs just changed the fate of the game. Ngidi too redeemed himself by getting a wicket and being relatively economical. Rabada was expensive but did the job and got the big wicket of Pollard. Markram and Linde were expensive but overall a very good display from South Africa.

Chasing 168, West Indies got off to a good start as the pair of Simmons and Lewis started with a 55-run stand. Both the openers departed in quick succession. Holder and Hetmyer then added a 33-run stand but once again wickets fell in quick succession as the hosts lost 3 wickets for 14 runs. That created a sense of danger but Russell's 25 calmed that. Not for long though as his cameo did not last long. Pooran who had taken his time to settle failed to capitalize and finish the game for his side. Too much was left to do in the final over and Allen was unable to get his side over the line.

Fantastic bowling in the death from Rabada and Nortje. Their brilliance in the final two overs has seen their side snatch victory from a very difficult situation and take the lead in the series. West Indies, with all their power hitters, have thrown away a game that looked to be in their grasp.
SIX! It won't matter! Full toss on middle, Fabian Allen muscles it over deep square leg for a maximum. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 1 RUN.
Pitches it again on leg, Allen fails to get any bat on it. This is the third time the ball went through his legs.
Fuller length on leg, Allen tucks it towards deep square leg. The fielder at the deep misfields and allows the batters to grab a second. Pressure on everyone right now.
Full again on leg, Allen looks to flick but misses. The ball went through his legs again.
FOUR! Full again on leg, Fabian Allen whips it towards deep backward square for a boundary.
Fullish delivery on leg, Allen looks to dig it out. The ball through his legs into the keeper's mitts.
WIDE! Starts with a wide down the leg side. Allen misses his flick. Wide called.
15 needed off the final over and Bavuma has given the ball to Rabada to bowl the final over as expected.
Fuller length again, on off, Bravo pushes it back to the bowler. This means West Indies will need 15 off the last over.
Dwayne Bravo is the new man in.
Pooran has decided to review. He has been adjudged LBW but he has decided to take it upstairs. He has not stopped walking and this looks like a review out of hope than anything else.

OUT! LBW! Fuller length on middle, right into the blockhole, Nicholas Pooran went for the paddle scoop but didn't get any bat on it. The ball struck his pads and rolled towards short fine leg. Nortje appeals for an LBW and the umpire doesn't hesitate to raise his finger. Pooran takes a review. Ultra Edge confirms no bat. The Ball Tracker shows all three reds. The on-field decision will stay. Anrich Nortje gets an important wicket at an important time. This could prove to be a crucial wicket at the dying stages of the match.
Fuller on off, Pooran pushes it back to the bowler. 15 needed in 8 delivereis.
Full toss again on middle, whipped towards mid-wicket The call is for two and Pooran gets it easily. Excellent running between the wickets.
Low full toss on off, knocked to long off for just one.
Fires a yorker on leg, Pooran flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Penultimate over of the game. The crucial over and who will Bavuma go to?  It will be Anrich Nortje.
Fuller length delivery on off, Pooran pushes it towards mid off for a sharp single.
Back of a length delivery on off, pulled towards deep square leg for one.
Short and wide outside off, Allen swings but does not get any bat to it.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
SIX! CRUNCHED! Length delivery on off, Nicholas Pooran watches the ball closely, powers it over cow corner for a maximum. 20 needed in 16 deliveries.
Full and outside off, Pooran swings his blade but misses.
Fabian Allen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time it's taken! Fuller length again on off, Andre Russell muscles it towards long on. Aiden Markram takes a sharp diving catch to his right to dismiss Russell. Anrich Nortje has the last laugh. Went for two biggies but gets the big fish eventually.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller length outside off, Russell guides it to backward point.
WIDE! Outside the tramline again. Wide called.
Low full toss on middle, Pooran works it off the inside edge towards short fine leg for a run.

DROPPED! OH, DEAR! How costly will this prove? Short ball on middle, Andre Russell went for another big shot but mistimes it. The ball goes off the top edge towards covers. Temba Bavuma goes for the catch and spills it. A single taken. Did he just drop the match there?
WIDE! Way outside off, Russell leaves it alone. Wided.
SIX! KABOOM! Anrich Nortje in pressure now! Back of a length delivery on off, Andre Russell makes room and muscles it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
SIX! MUSCLE RUSSELL! Fuller length on off, Andre Russell lofts it over long off for a biggie.
Change in bowling. Anrich Nortje is back on.
Fuller on middle, swept to deep mid-wicket for a single. Just 4 runs off the over. End of a brilliant spell by Tabraiz Shamsi. Conceded only 13 runs in his four-over quota and picked up 2 wickets.
Flighted delivery on leg, spinning in, Russell dances down the track and manages to get a bat on it.
Loopy delivery outside off, Pooran pokes it to point for a single.
On off, tapped towards point.
Floated delivery on off, Russell slaps it towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Tossed up outside off, worked down to long on for a single.
Slower ball bowled into the surface. It is to the left of cover. The fielder there dives and denies Russell the single. 48 needed off the final 5 overs.
WIDE! Low full toss wide outside off but once again on the wrong side of the tramline.
Fuller on off, Pooran checks his drive to cover for one.
Slower ball bowled into the surface. Pooran looks to punch but misses. South Africa at this stage were 10 runs ahead and lost 2 wickets fewer.
Full on the leg side, Pooran looks to flick but misses. The ball kisses his pad on its way to the keeper.
Length ball on off, Russell punches it to cover for one.  Bavuma has a shy at the bowler's end but ends up hitting Bavuma.
WIDE! Rabada looks to go wide of Russell but goes a little too extra wide. Russell swings but to no avail.

SIX! Russell gets hold of this one. And when that happens the ball is usually out of the boundary. Nothing new here. Low full toss on middle. Russell picks it up and smacks it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Floated on middle, Russell knocks it to long on and keeps the strike. Just 4 off the over.
Slightly short and turning in. Russell looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Short and spinning away from wide outside off. Pooran punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Slower through the air on middle. Russell taps it to the on side and takes a quick single.
Darted on the pads. Russell looks to flick but misses and the ball goes to the on side of his pad.
Short around off, Pooran cuts it through point for a single.
Another off pace bouncer. This is around off, Pooran hops and hits it to deep mid-wicket for one. 7 off the over and a wicket. 62 needed off 42 balls now.
Slower bumper! It is on the leg side but Pooran has shuffled inside the stumps so it's not been wided.
Russell is off the mark! Full on off, Russell taps it to mid on and takes a single.
The new man in is Andre Russell.

OUT! BOWLED! Kagiso Rabada gets the dangerous Kieron Pollard! Quicker delivery on middle and off, Kieron Pollard charges down the track. He is beaten by the pace as this one was a 143kph delivery, the ball goes through Pollard's bat and shatters the stumps. West Indies in deep trouble. Half the side back in the hut now.
Low full toss on middle, Pooran clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Pooran flicks it with soft hands back to the keeper. De Kock couldn't collect it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Change in bowling.  Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Flatter delivery on leg, Pooran tucks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single.
Skipper, Kieron Pollard joins vice-captain, Pooran out in the middle.  71 needed in 50 deliveries.

OUT! TAKEN! That's the wicket South Africa was looking for! It is their ace bowler who strikes! Tossed it up outside off, little bit of turn away from the batsman, Shimron Hetmyer tries to club that over covers but didn't time that well. The ball goes straight into the hands of Kagiso Rabada at backward point. Shimron Hetmyer departs. Tabraiz Shamsi is pumped.
Commentary.Howout: c Kagiso Rabada b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy and full outside off, played through covers for a single.
BEATEN! Turn on offer, outside off, Pooran went for the drive but misses.
Tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Change in bowling. Tabraiz Shamsi is back on.
Length delivery on off, Pooran works it towards covers for another single. 72 needed in 54 balls.
On off, pushed towards covers for a quick single.
Short ball on middle, pulled towards deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Fuller length down the leg side, Pooran fails to get any bat as he looks to flick. Wide called.
Outside off, Pooran looks to drive but misses.
Fuller on the pads, Hetmyer went for the flick. The ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg. The batters sneak a leg bye.
WIDE! Short ball down the leg side, Hetmyer pulls but misses. Wided.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lungi Ngidi gets the breakthrough! Good length delivery on off, Jason Holder looks to slash it on the leg side but miscues it. The ball went straight up in the air and Aiden Markram settles under it at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: The highly-rated and extremely talented, Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat.
WIDE! Down the leg side. De Kock does well to dive to his left and collect the ball.
Flighted on off, Holder nudges it to cover and keeps the strike. Halfway of the innings done. West Indies are 89/2. Need another 79 off 60 balls.
Floated on off, Hetmyer milks it to cover and rotates.
On the pads, Holder clips it to the on side for one.
SIX! Holder joins the party! Tossed up in the slot on middle. Holder goes over mid-wicket. There is a man in the deep but he is a mere spectator.
Floated outside off, Hetmyer looks to go over covers but misses. De Kock cannot hold onto it as it hits his finger and goes behind. They take a bye.
SIX! BOOM! Do not bother looking, this was six the moment it left the bat. Short around off, Hetmyer gets on his back foot and smashes it over the cow corner region for a biggie.
Short on middle, Hetmyer tucks it to mid-wicket. He calls for two but they need to settle for one.
Aiden Markram is back into the attack.
Floated on middle, Holder plays it to long on for one.
Smart cricket! Follows the biggie with a single. On the pads, Hetmyer clips it behind square on the leg side for one.
SIX! Magnificent from Hetmyer! Floated delivery wide outside off. Hetmyer gets on his knee and smokes it over extra cover for a biggie. 11 off the over already, pressure on Linde now.
Tossed up on off, Holder follows the boundary with a single towards long on.
FOUR! Nice shot! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Holder gets outside the delivery and goes inside out over extra cover for a boundary.

On the pads, Holder looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pad, then de Kock's glove and lobs behind. They take a leg bye. Very good start from Shamsi. Just 2 runs and a leg bye along with the wicket of Lewis.
Googly on off. Hetmyer plays it with the spin towards deep mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
Shimron Hetmyer is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A fortuitous wicket for Shamsi but he will take it. Lewis will be kicking himself as this was a nothing delivery. A loopy ball on the leg side, Lewis looks to slog it over deep mid-wicket. He does not time it well and ends up picking out Rassie van der Dussen in the deep to perfection. He makes no mistake and Shamsi strikes in his very first over.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on middle, Lewis keeps it out.
Shorter on off, Holder punches it to cover for one.

Was there a little nick on it? Shamsi starts with one around the leg side. Holder looks to flick but misses. The ball clips something on its way to the keeper. De Kock fails to hold onto it. Looking at de Kock and Shamsi's reaction, it looks like there was a feather on it.
Tabraiz Shamsi is introduced into the attack.
Floated on middle, Holder knocks it to long on and gets off the mark. He shall also keep the strike.
Jason Holder walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Very sharp catch from de Kock and Linde draws the first blood. Simmons departs after a solid start and this is exactly what South Africa needed. Turn and bounce for Linde. He always extracts some bounce and it has worked in his favor. Shortish and pitching on middle and off. It pitches and turns away. Simmons looks to slap it through covers but gets a feather on it. De Kock behind the stumps takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b George Linde

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter on off, Simmons plays it to point.
Good effort from Hendricks! Short around off, Simmons cuts it and gets it past the man at point. Hendricks in the deep runs to his left and saves it before the ropes with a slide.
On the pads, Lewis turns it to the on side for one.
FOUR! Poor ball! Half tracker on the pads. Lewis says thank you very much and swivels it through backward square leg for a boundary.
George Linde is back into the attack.

Excellent over. Just a solitary run of the final over of the Powerplay. The last ball is low full toss on middle. Simmons pushes it back to the bowler. Powerplay done, West Indies are 48/0. South Africa at this stage were 51/2.
Full and wide outside off. Simmons looks to hit it through covers but gets an inside edge which sees the ball go to the keeper all along the ground.
Back of a length delivery outside off. Simmons throws his bat at it but to no avail.
Good ball! Right in the blockhole. Simmons does well to jam it out.
Fullish ball outside off, Simmons swings but to no avail.
Full around off, Lewis looks to hit it straight but gets an inside edge. The ball goes away from th stumps and through backward square leg for one.
Anrich Nortje is back on but this time from the other end.
Fuller length on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.

Low full toss on leg, Simmons clears his front leg and tries to go down the leg side. He gets a leading edge and the ball goes towards long on. The batters take a couple of runs The throw comes to de Kock who fails to collect it cleanly. The batters snatch another run of the overthrows.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Short of a length delivery on middle, Lendl Simmons hammers it over the bowler's head for a maximum.

Fires a yorker on off, Simmons squeezes it out to backward point. South African players think it's a catch as Simmons has hit it directly. The umpires refer it to the third umpire. The soft signal is not out. The third umpire too confirms it hit the ground and got carried on one bounce.
The umpires have gone upstairs to check the legitimacy of the catch. The soft signal is NOT OUT! There needs to be conclusive evidence for it to be overturned.
Short ball on middle, Lewis pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Low full toss on middle, punched towards mid off.
Fifth bowler in as many overs. Kagiso Rabada is on now.
Low full toss on middle, Simmons hits it towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length on middle, Simmons hops and plays it to point.
Fuller length on off, Lewis hits it hard towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Smashed! Short ball on middle, Evin Lewis pulls it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.

Good length ball outside off, Lewis looks to go big as he swings his blade on the off side. He gets a thick outside edge and went over backward point. Shamsi and Hendricks chase the ball and keeps it to two.
Length delivery on off, worked towards point for a single.
Lungi Ngidi is into the attack from the other end.
Dipping full toss on middle, Lewis plays it towards cover-point. He is not happy as he thinks it was a no ball.
Back of a hand delivery outside off, Lewis leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery on off, Simmons taps it to point for one.
Length delivery outside off, Simmons pushes it through covers off the front foot. He gets a couple.
FOUR! What a shot! Fuller length on off, Lendl Simmons leans into the shot, drives it through covers for a glorious boundary.
Nortje starts with a full ball on middle. Lewis plays it to mid-wicket for one.
Change in bowling. Time for pace now as Anrich Nortje is into the attack.
Floated delivery outside off, Simmons again looks to defend but gets beaten.
Outside off, cut to point.
BEATEN! Tossed up outside off, Simmons looks to defend but misses.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Simmons drives it through covers for a couple.
Floated it up on off, nudged on the leg side for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Poor start from Aiden Markram! Bowls it down the leg side. Lewis misses his sweep shot. Quinton de Kock fails to collect the ball and races away to the fine leg fence.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Lewis misses his flick. Wided.
Floated delivery on leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Aiden Markram to bowl from the other end.
Flatter on the pads, nudged to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! UP AND OVER! Flatter delivery on off, Evin Lewis heaves it over long off for a maximum. Playing the shot to perfection.
Loopy ball on off, Evin Lewis cuts it very late past point. He gets a couple of runs.
Full again on leg, Simmons whips it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up on leg, Lewis works it towards square leg for one.
Starts with a full ball on off, Lewis plays it towards covers.
